Home.description: Today's spiritual and physical agenda. Header shows the current date and Liturgical Season with appropriate color tint. Cards for Today's Meal (highlighting fasting rules if any), Today's Workout, and Daily Devotion.
Home.layout: ScrollView with generous padding (padding: 24). Cards stacked with marginBottom: 24. Elegant header using Cormorant Garamond.

Meals.description: Weekly meal planner. Shows 'AI Suggested' meals for the week. Highlights Friday as 'Abstinence' with a subtle fish icon or black/red text. Focus on rustic, simple presentation.
Meals.layout: Horizontal scroll for days of the week, vertical scroll for meals. Each meal card includes an image and a liturgical context tag.

Workouts.description: Weekly workout schedule. Themed by season (e.g., Lenten discipline, Easter joy). Includes prayer intentions for each workout.
Workouts.layout: List view of workouts. Use nature/fitness images. Each workout card has a 'Start with Prayer' button.

Calendar.description: Monthly liturgical calendar. Color-coded dots or background tints for seasons/feast days. Tap a day to see saints and readings.
Calendar.layout: Grid-based calendar view. Bottom half of screen displays details for the selected day in an elegant, parchment-styled modal or card.

Profile.description: User settings, Google Auth state, dietary preferences, and fitness goals.
Profile.layout: Standard list layout with grouped settings. Button for 'Sign in with Google'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY Expo standard components (View, Text, ScrollView) and StyleSheet.create(). Do not use Tailwind CSS.
Ensure react-native-safe-area-context is used for the main container to handle notches.
Use @expo/vector-icons (Ionicons or MaterialCommunityIcons) for tab bar and UI icons.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid for testing (e.g. data-testid='start-workout-button').
Avoid typical bright modern SaaS colors. Keep the UI feeling like an illuminated manuscript: parchment background (#FAF9F6), dark sapphire (#1C2841) for primary actions, gold (#D4AF37) accents.
Use the specific liturgical colors provided for badges and calendar highlights.
Apply generous padding (24px) for breathing room, and use the card shadow styles provided for subtle depth.
In the Tab navigation, use 5 tabs: Home, Meals, Workouts, Calendar, Profile.
Do not use placeholders for images; use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs in the images section.
